The '''Kathol Republic Navy''' was the space defense force for the [[Kathol Republic]]. The Navy patrolled the Republic's territory and defended it against outside aggressors. The backbone of the navy was made up of at least eight [[Marauder-class Assault Corvette/Legends|''Marauder''-class corvettes]], and the fleet was considered obsolete by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and of little threat. The fleet was commanded by [[Hendric Faile]].

Two corvettes, including the ''[[Bravado III]]'', [[Battle of Episol|engaged]] forces allied to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] posing as a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] vessel in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].
